claims.value: 80B total parameters, 3B activated MoE. Features hybrid Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention, 512 MoE experts with 10 activated. 48 layers, hidden dim 2048, 16K context native up to 256K, extensible to 1M.
claims.evidence: Hybrid Layout: 12 * (3 * (Gated DeltaNet -> MoE) -> 1 * (Gated Attention -> MoE))

claims.value: This is a text-in, text-out instruct model for Qwen3-Next.
